text: Fear is the subject of 1 of 5 books (Brave Bora): it is named on page 2, called okay by a parent, rehearsed on a toy, and peaks at intensity 4 just before the solution. Evidence: 1 of 1 works, one book, confidence HYPOTHESIS. Proposal for `EmotionalState.intensity`: Open question, not a recommendation: whether named fear followed by adult support could be allowed mid-story. One book cannot answer it.
